name: Painting
comment: Represents a painting object with its musical and cultural semantic links. The musicalSemanticNotesId and culturalSemanticNotesId are crucial fields that link to expert-created records representing the core knowledge of the painting and music making.

fields.name: musicalSemanticNotesId
fields.comment: Object ID of the musical semantic notes record created by domain experts. Links to the core musical knowledge of the painting.

fields.name: culturalSemanticNotesId
fields.comment: Object ID of the cultural semantic notes record created by domain experts. Links to the core cultural knowledge of the painting.

fields.name: audioVisualReferenceNotesIds
fields.comment: List of object IDs of audio-visual references added by the musician.
